opening.argument: The central pitch is a rapid, outsized return: the speaker claims to have used 0.3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB in minutes. Viewers are then directed to connect MetaMask, deposit BNB, and execute what is called a “flash loan attack,” while the description instructs them to send BNB to a deployed contract and says a larger amount produces more in each swap. The speaker further states, “The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment.” That combination of a requested cryptocurrency transfer, a contract-based procedure, and extraordinary returns supports the alleged promotion. The destination, transactions, and any resulting losses remain unverified, but those limitations do not remove the character of the described offer.
